purpose: Certify the EA production system by proving representative faults are detected, unsafe promotion is blocked, deterministic repair/rollback/resume paths execute, re-testing occurs, and production verification remains authoritative.
invariants: failure injection must not touch external production
no scenario may authorize production promotion during certification
bad feature flag must exercise kill-switch behavior
failed or partial deployment must exercise rollback behavior
worker or Temporal interruption must exercise durable resume behavior
repair paths must be re-tested before verification
COMPLETE remains evidence-backed rather than inferred
